user.title: Connect to Cloudflare
user.description: Create an API token at dash.cloudflare.com > My Profile > API Tokens > Create Custom Token. The README lists the permissions to tick. Read-only permissions are enough for alerts; Edit permissions are only needed for the block, lock and disable actions.

reauth_confirm.title: Cloudflare token needs replacing
reauth_confirm.description: Cloudflare rejected the saved token. Paste a new one with the same permissions.

error.invalid_auth: Cloudflare rejected this token, or it cannot list accounts (add Account Settings: Read).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Cloudflare. Try again in a minute.
error.no_accounts: This token does not give access to any account.
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Cloudflare account.

abort.already_configured: This Cloudflare account is already set up.

data.new_ip_scope: Treat an IP as new when it is
data.persistent_notification: Show a notification in Home Assistant for each new IP

data_description.watch_tunnel_visitors: Uses Cloudflare traffic analytics for the hostnames routed through your tunnels.
data_description.watch_tunnel_connectors: Alerts if a tunnel connector shows up from an IP it has not used before, which can mean the tunnel token is used somewhere else.
data_description.watched_sites: Hostnames like media.example.com, one per line. Each gets its own device showing who visited in the last 24 hours. Must be a proxied hostname in this account.
data_description.trusted_ips: One per line or comma separated. Ranges like 192.0.2.0/24 work.
data_description.ipinfo_token: Leave empty for light use. A free token from ipinfo.io raises the lookup limit.

options.source: new to that app or hostname

block_ip.name: Block IP
block_ip.description: Blocks an IP (or range) on every site in the Cloudflare account with an IP Access rule.

ip.name: IP address
ip.description: IPv4, IPv6, or a range like 203.0.113.0/24.

note.name: Note
note.description: Shown next to the rule in Cloudflare.

unblock_ip.name: Unblock IP
unblock_ip.description: Removes the block rule for this IP.

lock_access_app.name: Lock Access app
lock_access_app.description: Adds a 'Block everyone' policy to the app so nobody can log in until it is unlocked.

unlock_access_app.name: Unlock Access app
unlock_access_app.description: Removes the block policy added by Lock Access app.

disable_tunnel.name: Disable tunnel
disable_tunnel.description: Makes every hostname on the tunnel return an error page, and saves the current routes so Enable tunnel can restore them. Only for tunnels managed in the Cloudflare dashboard. If Home Assistant itself is reached through this tunnel, you will lose remote access through it.

enable_tunnel.name: Enable tunnel
enable_tunnel.description: Restores the routes saved when the tunnel was disabled.

forget_ip.name: Forget IP
forget_ip.description: Removes an IP from the known list, so the next time it shows up you get alerted again.
